segments.contextAfter: `item`: A binding to an optional source of truth for the sheet. When `item` is non-`nil`, the system passes the item’s content to the modifier’s closure. You display this content in a sheet that you create that the system displays to the user. If `item` changes, the system dismisses the sheet and replaces it with a new one using the same process.
